invariants.text: Employee.employee_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
The email address of an employee must be valid.
The age of an employee must be between 18 and 70 inclusive.
The salary of an employee must be a positive number.
When creating an employee, the email must pass validation before being stored.
When creating an employee, the age must be within the range of 18 to 70.
When creating an employee, the salary must be greater than zero.
Updating an employee's age must ensure it remains between 18 and 70.
Updating an employee's salary must ensure it remains positive.
Deleting an employee removes the employee record from the database.
The salary field cannot be set to zero or negative values.
